left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Ages 18-59
  -  Histologically confirmed nonalcoholic steatohepatitis  [OR] and fibrosis (stage 1-3) from liver biopsy
  -  Able to row on an indoor rowing apparatus
  -  Not participating in regular physical exercise (more than 60 minutes  [OR] of moderate intensity or 30 minutes of vigorous intensity exercise per week)
  -  Not actively trying to lose weight through a dietary approach
  -  No absolute contra-indications to exercise: recent (<6 months) acute cardiac event unstable angina, uncontrolled dysrhythmias causing symptoms  [OR] or hemodynamic compromise, symptomatic aortic stenosis, uncontrolled symptomatic heart failure, acute pulmonary embolus, acute myocarditis  [OR] or pericarditis, suspected or known dissecting aneurism  [OR] and acute systemic infection
  -  No other form of chronic liver disease (as confirmed by serology  [OR] and histology)
  -  No liver cirrhosis  [OR] (stage 4 fibrosis on liver biopsy) or a clinical diagnosis of cirrhosis as ascertained by a hepatologist
  -  No coronary artery disease  [OR] or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

right.raw_text:
-  No diagnosis of malignancy (except non-melanoma skin cancer)
  -  No past  [OR] or present history of portal hypertension (esophageal varices, [OR]  ascites, [OR]  hepatic encephalopathy)
  -  No use of immunosuppression  [OR] or chronic nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medication
  -  No more than 14 drinks per week (if male) [OR]  or 7 drinks a week (if female) in the last 2 years
  -  Cognitively able to provide consent
  -  Able to read, write, and understand English
  -  Transportation to the exercise and testing facility
